_doc: Factual eval for scripts/factual-eval.ts. accept: regexes (case-insensitive), any match = correct. reject: regexes naming a known-wrong answer; a match with no accept match = confident-wrong even when hedged. abstain_ok: an honest 'I'm not sure / can't verify / does not exist' counts as appropriate. Expected answers are as of 2026-10; recent-event items have abstain_ok true because only a web search can settle them.
